provenance.note: Every null below must come from the live device tree or dmesg of THIS phone. Do not copy addresses from another MT6879 device.

bootloader.sweet: ABL, fastboot boot de shim (nada flasheado)
bootloader.how_to_measure: fastboot getvar all; probar 'fastboot boot boot_stock.img'

boot_image_format.sweet: Android boot v2 + DTB, payload = shim + kernel + ADT + args
boot_image_format.manaus_value: Android boot header v4, BOARD_KERNEL_PAGESIZE=4096, base 0x3fff8000, dtb_offset 0x07c88000, ramdisk_offset 0x26f08000, cmdline bootopt=64S3,32N2,64N2, GKI + vendor_boot, A/B

timer.how_to_measure: clock-frequency del CPU node; leer CNTFRQ_EL0 desde el shim

mpidr_topology.sweet: un cluster homogeneo, Aff1 = numero de nucleo
mpidr_topology.how_to_measure: reg de cpu@* en el FDT + MPIDR_EL1 en runtime

page_size.how_to_measure: MMFR0_EL1 (ID_AA64MMFR0_EL1) desde el shim; confirmar 16K en el TRM de A78/A55

framebuffer_handoff.how_to_measure: chosen/bootargs, reserved-memory, nodo mtkfb/framebuffer, dmesg de LK; comprobar si el panel sigue encendido tras bootear recovery

ufs_host.how_to_measure: nodo ufshc@*/ufs_mem en el FDT; dmesg 'ufshcd'; clocks/phys/regulators del nodo

userdata.sweet: HFS+ journaled dentro de userdata (se borra Android)
userdata.how_to_measure: fstab.mt6879, tamano real de userdata, filesystem actual

touch.how_to_measure: /sys/bus/i2c/devices/*/name, nodo táctil del FDT (compatible, reg, interrupts, reset-gpio, vdd), dmesg

keys.how_to_measure: nodos key-* del FDT, PMIC real (MT6359/MT6369?), pwrap

pmic.how_to_measure: compatible de pwrap/pmic en el FDT; dmesg 'mt635'

uart.sweet: no hay (debug UART cableado como SPI)
uart.how_to_measure: nodos serial@* del FDT, pads de test, dmesg 'earlycon'/'console='

ramoops.sweet: no usado; log persistente propio en userdata (parche 0047)
ramoops.how_to_measure: reserved-memory ramoops/ramoops_region en el FDT y /sys/fs/pstore
